signals.text: Martinez's future at Man Utd in doubt - Thursday's gossip. Lisandro Martinez's future in doubt at Manchester United, Newcastle's Bazoumana Toure eyed by Manchester United and Arsenal, Getafe interested in free agent Jadon Sancho, plus more.
'Shameless' - Mourinho critical of Vinicius Jr ban timing. Real Madrid forward Vinicius Jr will miss El Clasico against Barcelona after being given a four-game ban.
